content.description: Find below an overview of Shimmy, followed by a more detailed look into different areas of the project. Here is a succinct overview of the Shimmy Platform:. Shimmy is a user-centric, purpose-driven social media platform, built for impact. It enables users to create meaningful content that sows the seeds of positive change and development across active communities. You can start or join 'A Shimmy' you care about, get access to exclusive content and interact privately with your real network.
